title: My first iOS game - The Last Greenhouse
author: krzysztof_radomski
selftext:
Just happy to share :) My first game published on a proper platform is a free to play greenhouse builder. Initially I was exploring consistency and unique art direction with gemini generated assets, and wanted to build a 3d jigsaw game, but things changed along the way.

It is built on three.js, has no game engine or framework on top of it, just plain JS modules bundled with Vite, and is wrapped with Capacitor. Next app is being made with React Native, and I also experiment with pure Swift, because I am not yet sure what tech stack to commit to. 

  
Has 2 modes, chapter progression and freeplay mode. You just build things to relax, is all.
